You said:
Which iPhone calendar apps are suitable for rotating shift work, overnight shifts and seeing a work rota beside personal appointments? Distinguish specialist shift planners from ordinary calendar apps and cite official sources.
ChatGPT said:

For an iPhone user working rotating shifts, overnight shifts, and irregular days off, I would prioritise a specialist shift planner that can display personal appointments alongside work shifts.

The important distinction is that shift planners understand work patterns, whereas ordinary calendar apps are designed primarily to display events and appointments.

1. Specialist shift planners
1. Supershift
Best overall fit

Supershift explicitly supports custom rotations such as 4-on/4-off, DuPont, Panama and 2-2-3 patterns. It also supports multiple shifts per day, coloured shift types, reports and sharing.

Crucially, Supershift Pro can show appointments from external calendars alongside your shifts, and export shifts to Apple Calendar, Google Calendar or Outlook. 
App Store
+1

This is the strongest documented option for the combination you described. For overnight work, you can define night shifts as a separate shift type, rather than treating every working day as identical.

The basic app is free with in-app purchases, but external calendar integration and export are Pro features.

Official source: Supershift App Store listing.

2. My Shift Planner

Best alternative for complex rotas

Supports rotating days and nights, custom patterns, overtime, annual leave and multiple schedules.

Its Pro Pack includes calendar synchronisation, importing personal appointments into the app's Notes section, and a calendar overlay for comparing two schedules. This is useful, although not necessarily the same as a fully integrated appointment timeline. 
App Store
+1

Official feature explanation · App Store

3. ShiftCal

Best for emergency-service shift cycles

ShiftCal is primarily designed for firefighters and emergency-service personnel on 24-hour or platoon-based schedules. It supports multiple shift schedules and colour-coded platoons.

It is less compelling as a general personal calendar because the official documentation focuses on shift-cycle display rather than integrated personal appointments. 
FF Calendar
+1

Official iOS information

2. Ordinary calendar apps

These are suitable for seeing shifts beside appointments, including events crossing midnight. They are less convenient for creating complex rotating rosters.

Apple Calendar — best free combined calendar

Supports separate colour-coded calendars, iCloud and Google accounts, subscriptions, month details and multi-day views. It can display overnight events with their actual start and end times, but doesn't offer specialist shift-pattern templates. 
Apple Support
+2

Apple's official multiple-calendar guide

Google Calendar — best for cross-platform schedules

A practical choice when your personal appointments already live in Google Calendar. You can maintain a separate work calendar and see its events with personal commitments. Overnight shifts can be entered as timed events spanning two dates, but complex rotations require manual setup or an external shift planner.

Official Google Calendar Help

Fantastical — best advanced calendar viewer

Offers day, week and month views, plus Calendar Sets to show work and personal calendars together or separately. Particularly useful when several calendars are already synchronised. It is not a specialist rotating-shift generator.

4. Important considerations for overnight shifts

For a shift running from 19:00 Monday to 07:00 Tuesday, check that the app records the shift as a genuine 12-hour interval across midnight, rather than just marking Monday as a night shift. That matters when checking whether a Tuesday morning appointment conflicts with work.

Also distinguish calendar export (copying shifts into another calendar) from calendar import (seeing personal appointments inside the shift planner). Supershift explicitly documents both as Pro features; My Shift Planner documents calendar sync and personal appointment import, but with a different presentation. 
App Store
+1

My recommendation is to start with Supershift. It has the clearest officially documented combination of custom rotations, night-shift planning and external personal-calendar integration. Try entering one complete rotation and a shift crossing midnight before paying for Pro.

The deciding question is whether you want to see personal appointments inside the shift-planning app, or whether you're happy to create shifts in one app and see everything together in Apple Calendar. Both approaches work, but they lead to different choices.
